The first release: a messenger inside the Minecraft chat, from 1.19.2 to 26.3.

- Chat bubbles with faces, names and times; replies, editing, deleting, reactions, @mentions, "is typing"
- Private chats with read receipts
- Stickers and emoji from the server, pictures (file, screenshot, clipboard), voice messages
- Polls, search through every chat, 40 languages
- For servers: mutes, chat-plugin and LuckPerms/Vault ranks, H2/MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL, S3 storage

See the [README](https://github.com/S1nuxoff/InGame-Messenger#readme) for everything and the
[server guide](https://github.com/S1nuxoff/InGame-Messenger/blob/main/docs/server.md) for setup.

## Which file

Players need the mod; servers need the mod (same loader as the server) or the plugin. Fabric and Quilt also need Fabric API.

| Minecraft | Fabric, Quilt | NeoForge | Forge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.19.2 | `fabric-1.19.2` | | `forge-1.19.2` |
| 1.20, 1.20.1 | `fabric-1.20.1` | | `forge-1.20.1` (1.20.1 only) |
| 1.20.3, 1.20.4 | `fabric-1.20.4` | | `forge-1.20.4` (1.20.4 only) |
| 1.20.5, 1.20.6 | `fabric-1.20.6` | `neoforge-1.20.6` (1.20.6 only) | `forge-1.20.6` (1.20.6 only) |
| 1.21, 1.21.1 | `fabric-1.21.1` | `neoforge-1.21.1` | `forge-1.21.1` (1.21.1 only) |
| 1.21.4 | `fabric-1.21.4` | `neoforge-1.21.4` | `forge-1.21.4` |
| 1.21.5 | `fabric-1.21.5` | `neoforge-1.21.5` | `forge-1.21.5` |
| 1.21.6 – 1.21.8 | `fabric-1.21.8` | `neoforge-1.21.8` | `forge-1.21.8` (1.21.8 only) |
| 1.21.9, 1.21.10 | `fabric-1.21.10` | `neoforge-1.21.10` | `forge-1.21.10` (1.21.10 only) |
| 1.21.11 | `fabric-1.21.11` | `neoforge-1.21.11` | `forge-1.21.11` |
| 26.1 – 26.1.2 | `fabric-26.1` | `neoforge-26.1` | `forge-26.1` (26.1.2 only) |
| 26.2 | `fabric-26.2` | `neoforge-26.2` | `forge-26.2` |
| 26.3 | `fabric-26.3` | `neoforge-26.3` | `forge-26.3` |

**Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Folia** (1.20 and newer): `ingamemessenger-plugin`.
